A '''point-defense laser cannon''', also called a '''point-defense cannon''' when not a [[laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]], was a kind of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] emplacement, typically [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]] or light [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]],<ref name="SotGSE">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref> that were used to defend large capital starships against smaller [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="SotG">''[[Starships of the Galaxy]]''</ref> Point-defense cannons were also used to defend against missiles.<ref name="FoC">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref> [[Adumar/Legends|Adumari]] [[Meteor-class Aerial Fort|''Meteor''-class Aerial Fort]]s had their laser cannons optimized for shooting down incoming missiles in this way.<ref name="SoA">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>

[[Vindicator-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Vindicator''-class heavy cruisers]] were armed with point-defense laser cannons and point-defense light ion cannons.<ref name="SotG" />
